thread:
maya_r: quick sync — we need a tiny observability MVP for customers who keep asking for cost + error correlation. goal: minimal launch that still solves the ask.

maria_k: customers repeatedly request: route-level spend, error hotspots, and a fast path to traces when available. keep exports/offline reporting for later.

samir: dev constraints: avoid bulk trace ingest. plan: lightweight trace linking (lookup by trace_id) + sampling presets. ensure trace_id propagates in legacy ingestion or fallback gracefully.
nick_b: propose acceptance checklist: (1) route spend row w/ 7d sparkline (2) error hotspot table w/ counts (3) "Open trace" action that deep-links if trace exists else shows "not available" (4) sampling presets: low/med/high (5) PD webhook MVP.
emily: i'll produce a micro-mock (single-row focused) and sample copy for retention warning.
maria_k: rollout idea: 7 pilot orgs for 48h, monitor median token latency and trace-forwarder error rate. acceptance: <3% median latency delta and trace-forwarder errors <5%.
samir: infra checklist: sampling flag in routing, ensure serializer passthrough of trace_id, add circuit-breaker for trace-forwarding, and emit per-route KV hit metrics.
opsbot: deploybot: feature gate created: name=obs-mvp-small, env=staging, owners=[samir,nick_b]
maya_r: decision: ship the small MVP with the items above; gate extended retention and full trace capture behind enterprise. owners assigned, reconvene after mocks + infra doc in 48h.
